related_questions.question: Is brachytherapy the same as radiation therapy?
related_questions.snippet: Brachytherapy (brak-e-THER-uh-pee) is a procedure used to treat certain types of cancer and other conditions. It involves placing radioactive material inside the body. This is sometimes called internal radiation. Another type of radiation, called external radiation, is more common than brachytherapy.
